updates.section.name: Updates
updates.honest: Notification only: download the new version and replace the app. Verified in-app updates are planned.
updates.sha: Compare the SHA-256 shown on the release page.
updates.disclosure: IntelyIDE contacts api.github.com once a day. It sends nothing but your IP address and the app version in the User-Agent.
updates.disclosure.title: Update check
updates.skippedDesc: The status bar hides this version. A newer release shows again.
updates.card.title: IntelyIDE {version} is available
updates.about.label: Updates
updates.err.timeout: GitHub did not answer in time.
updates.err.rateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again later.
updates.err.tooLarge: The answer was larger than expected and was ignored.
updates.err.badResponse: The answer could not be read.
updates.err.badUrl: The release link was not on the project's release pages and was ignored.
updates.err.badVersion: This build has no valid version number.
updates.err.testJail: Update checks are off in the test jail.
